channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: ABC Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us this Wednesday for ABC Night at Claremont Stadium featuring exciting matches and fun for everyone!

item.description: Get ready for the 2024/25 season! Whether you're experienced or new, this season will be exciting. Check out our launch dates for adults and juveniles.
